tools.name: agent-browser.setup
tools.description: Write the agent-browser unit. Does not download a browser.

tools.name: agent-browser.check
tools.description: Check the agent-browser unit recorded by agent-browser.setup.

tools.name: agent-browser.uninstall
tools.description: Delete the agent-browser folder under the self-hosted home. That folder holds the install, config, and state agent-browser.setup wrote.
